definitions.strict_support: Top-envelope UAS points, near-nadir training views only, regional UAS z-buffer visible, all 3x3 projected cells covered with range <=0.5m. Independent of DA3 residual magnitude.
definitions.visibility_limit: No external occluders supplied. Strict support reduces but does not certify physical visibility; oblique views omitted from error attribution.
definitions.da3_target_height_error: Along the actual image ray, world vertical component of (DA3 camera-Z minus reference camera-Z); does not assume camera-Z equals world height.
definitions.paired_outcome: Same reference points: change in distance to actual extracted triangles and proximity gained/lost. Reference-conditioned recall, not subset F1.
definitions.height_ray: Vertical first intersection of extracted surface at fixed 0.5m XY centres; top-surface diagnostic, not Gaussian correspondence or full surface quality.
definitions.causal_limit: All completed conditions share DA3 inputs; other supervision/schedules change. Shared UAS noise may correlate input residual and output error. No percentage of final error is assigned solely to DA3.
